mapper.select: SELECT t.topic_id AS topicId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.activity_time, t.create_time), '%m-%d') AS date, t.title, d.dept_name AS school, u.nick_name AS teacher FROM biz_research_topic t INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = t.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '0' INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = t.creator_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND t.topic_type IN ('NOTICE', 'SHARE') ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, t.topic_id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t.content_html FROM biz_research_topic t INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = t.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '0' INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = t.creator_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' WHERE t.topic_id = #{topicId} AND t.del_flag = '0' AND t.topic_type IN ('NOTICE', 'SHARE')

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.topic_id AS topicId, p.content_html AS contentHtml, t.title AS topicTitle, d.dept_name AS school, u.nick_name AS teacher, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.create_time, t.create_time), '%m-%d') AS date FROM biz_research_post p INNER JOIN biz_research_topic t ON t.topic_id = p.topic_id AND t.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN sys_dept td ON td.dept_id = t.dept_id AND td.del_flag = '0' AND td.status = '0' INNER JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.user_id = t.creator_id AND tu.del_flag = '0' AND tu.status = '0' INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '0' INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = p.author_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.content_html LIKE '%<img%' ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.content_html FROM biz_research_post p INNER JOIN biz_research_topic t ON t.topic_id = p.topic_id AND t.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN sys_dept td ON td.dept_id = t.dept_id AND td.del_flag = '0' AND td.status = '0' INNER JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.user_id = t.creator_id AND tu.del_flag = '0' AND tu.status = '0' INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '0' INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = p.author_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.del_flag = '0'

WITH raw_activity AS ( SELECT lesson_id, student_id, submit_time AS used_at FROM biz_student_answer WHERE submit_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND submit_time <= NOW() AND student_answer IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(student_answer) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT lesson_id, student_id, checkin_time FROM biz_lesson_checkin WHERE checkin_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND checkin_time <= NOW() UNION ALL SELECT lesson_id, student_id, create_time FROM biz_classroom_performance WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND create_time <= NOW() ), activity AS (
SELECT lesson_id, student_id, MAX(used_at) AS used_at FROM raw_activity GROUP BY lesson_id, student_id ), recent_class AS ( SELECT scope.scope_id, scope.lesson_id, scope.dept_id, scope.entry_year, scope.class_code, MAX(a.used_at) AS used_at, COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS participant_count FROM activity a
STRAIGHT_JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id = a.student_id STRAIGHT_JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' STRAIGHT_JOIN biz_lesson_class_scope scope ON scope.lesson_id = a.lesson_id AND scope.dept_id = u.dept_id AND scope.entry_year = s.entry_year AND scope.class_code = s.class_code STRAIGHT_JOIN biz_lesson l ON l.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id AND l.dept_id = scope.dept_id STRAIGHT_JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = scope.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '0' GROUP BY scope.scope_id, scope.lesson_id, scope.dept_id, scope.entry_year, scope.class_code ORDER BY used_at DESC, scope.scope_id DESC LIMIT 6 ), practical AS ( SELECT c.scope_id, COUNT(*) AS submitted_count, SUM(a.score IS NULL) AS pending FROM recent_class c INNER JOIN biz_student_answer a ON a.lesson_id = c.lesson_id INNER JOIN biz_lesson_question lq ON lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id AND lq.question_id = a.question_id INNER JOIN biz_question q ON q.question_id = a.question_id AND q.question_type = 'practical' INNER JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id = a.student_id AND s.entry_year = c.entry_year AND s.class_code = c.class_code INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.dept_id = c.dept_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' WHERE a.student_answer IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.student_answer) <> '' AND a.submit_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.scope_id ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.used_at, '%m-%d %H:%i') AS time, DATE_FORMAT(c.used_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS usageDay, d.dept_name AS school, teacher.nick_name AS teacher, l.lesson_title AS topic, c.entry_year AS entryYear, c.class_code AS classCode, d.school_type AS schoolType, c.participant_count AS participantCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_student s INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.entry_year = c.entry_year AND s.class_code = c.class_code AND u.dept_id = c.dept_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0') AS totalStudentCount, COALESCE(p.pending, 0) AS pending, COALESCE(p.submitted_count, 0) AS submittedCount FROM recent_class c INNER JOIN biz_lesson l ON l.lesson_id = c.lesson_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = c.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user teacher ON teacher.user_id = l.creator_id AND teacher.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN practical p ON p.scope_id = c.scope_id ORDER BY c.used_at DESC, c.scope_id DESC
